author: Newsweek
title: Donald Trump dwarfed by NATO leaders
text:
An unusually tall lineup of NATO leaders made this year's summit family photo stand out, with several allies matching or exceeding Trump's height.
to see more of our trusted coverage when you search. Donald Trump is accustomed to standing out in world leaders' family photos, thanks to his height.
But at this week's NATO summit in Ankara, Turkey, the U.S. president found himself looking up to several counterparts, including Albanian Prime Minister EdiThe annual gathering brought together an unusually tall lineup of heads of state and government, with Rama at 6-foot-7, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte and Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez also among leaders reported to stand around or above 6-foot-3. While comprehensive historical records of world leaders' heights do not exist, this year's summit appears to feature an unusually large concentration of towering political figures.
The result is a rare shift in the optics of the traditional NATO family photo. Trump is no longer the most physically imposing figure in the frame, with several allies matching or exceeding his stature. Rama appears to be the tallest leader attending this week's NATO summit. A former professional basketball player, Rama is listed at 6-foot-7 in biographical profiles dating to his playing career.
Merz is widely reported by German media to stand around 6-foot-6, placing him among the tallest leaders in the alliance, although no official government biography lists his height. Rutte is widely reported to be 6-foot-4. Prime Ministers Pedro Sánchez of Spain and Andrej Plenković of Croatia are said to stand around 6-foot-3, putting them roughly even with Trump. Other leaders are shorter by comparison, including Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan at about 6 feet.
French President Emmanuel Macron is reported to be 5-foot-7, while British Prime Minister Keir Starmer is reported to stand around 5-foot-8. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni is reported to be between 5-foot-3 and 5-foot-4. Trump is among the tallest U.S. presidents of the modern era, based on his publicly reported height, the White House physician recorded in May. The only U.S. presidents taller than Trump were Abraham Lincoln at 6-foot-4 and Lyndon Johnson at 6-foot-3 1/2, according to potus.com.
Thomas Jefferson was 6-foot-2 1/2. George Washington, Chester A. Arthur, Franklin D. Roosevelt, George H.W. Bush and Bill Clinton are listed at 6-foot-2, followed by Andrew Jackson, John F. Kennedy, Ronald Reagan and Barack Obama at 6-foot-1. NATO Comparisons When NATO leaders assembled for the summit's traditional family photo, the lineup offered an unusual visual reminder that stature in international politics can sometimes be measured in more than one way.
Trump is usually one of the more physically imposing figures in any diplomatic lineup. This time, though, he was flanked by leaders of comparable stature, creating a noticeably more level visual tableau. In 2016, Barack Obama was president during the NATO summit in 2016 in Warsaw, Poland. That year, Serbian Prime Minster Aleksandar Vučić towered over everyone at 6-foot-6, while Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau was listed at 6-foot-2.
George W. Bush, at 6 feet, was president during the NATO summit in 2006 in Riga, Latvia. French President Jacques Chirac was listed at 6-foot-2.4, while Canadian Prime Minister Stephen Harper was 6-foot-2.
